entries.subject_prompt: Subject: Nippaku Zanmu / 日白残无. Very long black/dark-purple hair with slightly curled ends, red eyes and TWO SMALL GOLDEN CONICAL HORNS wound with red cords and tassels. Patched green monk-like top with yellow edging and red lacing, high-waisted blue knee-length shorts and white under-layer visible at hems. Relaxed seated pose on a rough rock, one forearm resting on a raised knee, confident knowing smile; dignified intelligent oni, not a raging warrior. Distant hell-rock landscape with a small bonsai-like pine and a red dusk sky. No white hair or tiger-gang uniform.

entries.subject_prompt: Subject: Mitsugashira Enoko / 三头慧之子. White neck-length softly curled bob, red eyes, two blue-gray dog ears and exactly THREE blue-gray canine tails fanning behind her. Purple off-shoulder top with a wide white translucent ruffle and white zigzag waist pattern; pink skirt with rows of small rainbow triangles, a green orb on a purple cord at the neck. Large red mechanical bear-trap ornaments around BOTH WRISTS, open safely without biting skin; red ankle rings if visible. Confident playful wild mountain-dog girl in a green forest clearing, non-sexual fully covered. Not three heads, no shaman headdress, no nine tails.

entries.subject_prompt: Subject: Son Biten / 孙美天. Brown hair tied into TWO LOW PONYTAILS, red eyes, a slim golden circlet with paired curling motifs across forehead, one long slender brown monkey tail. GREEN asymmetrical sleeveless top with black trim, a golden-yellow waist sash, a bright BLUE wrap skirt, and white fur with black tiger-like markings as shoulder drape and hem trim, decorated with dark/gold cords and tassels. Hold a simple straight staff vertically at the side, physically continuous and not across her face. Energetic self-confident grin in a forest mountain sanctuary. Follow the reference green-and-blue outfit, NOT a red-and-white shrine outfit and no golden short hair.

entries.name: 天独铭
entries.subject_prompt: ORIGINAL PROJECT CHARACTER, not Mitsugashira Enoko. Subject: 天独铭 (project-original silver-haired vajra yokai). Adult woman with long straight SILVER hair, SILVER-GRAY eyes and a composed observant expression. Modest layered white and charcoal shrine-temple robes with deep indigo waist sash and restrained silver edging, a small single-pronged vajra-shaped bronze hair ornament. Hold one short ceremonial vajra at waist height, simple anatomically coherent hands, no blade through fingers. Quiet mossy stone temple court at dawn. No dog ears, no animal tails, no red bear traps, no borrowing another Touhou character's costume. Unique original design, not presented as official canon.

entries.name: 天肱
entries.subject_prompt: ORIGINAL PROJECT CHARACTER, not Son Biten. Subject: 天肱 (project-original energetic tengu woman). Adult woman with short tousled BROWN hair, warm BROWN eyes, friendly lively smile and naturally athletic strong arms. Practical modest charcoal-and-red mountain tengu vest over a white short-sleeved shirt, dark skirt-like utility wrap and cloth wrist guards, a simple brown scarf. A pair of modest black crow-feather wings in the background silhouette, small cloth cap rather than Megumu's blue tokin. One relaxed bent arm, other hand resting at waist. Windy forest mountain trail. No monkey tail or gold circlet, no fox ears, no copying an official costume. Original character interpretation based on the local game description.
